name: hud_ui_options_panel_effects_init_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_Effects::InitFromOptions reads the current effects level, constrains the selector for software acceleration, and applies the selected effects index.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40cb30 reads zOpt::GetEffectsLevelForCurrentHwMode, and when zVid::GetAccelerationOption is software it remaps level 0 to 1 and calls HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::SetVisibleRange(self, 1, 3), then calls SetIndexClamped with the resulting level.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_effects_init_from_options_smoke installs effects and acceleration option pointers, verifies software acceleration remaps zero to selector index 1 with visible range [1, 3), verifies nonzero software level 2 keeps that range, and verifies hardware acceleration applies level 0 without changing the visible range.
